interactions.conditions: Pin mux, clocks, UART error paths and timer modes must be verified against actual firmware and applicable errata
PA14 is both SWCLK and a BOOT0-capable package pin; inspect option bytes and power-cycle/debug sequence before recovery assumptions
NTC_SENSE accuracy depends on source impedance, acquisition time, VDDA/VREF, first-sample behavior and installed RC network

Board L J3 and adapter J1/J2 are DNP; use a straight pin-for-pin 1x5 cable, power the target, align both pin-1 marks and the 20-pin shroud key, keep J1.19 isolated, and verify fitment, continuity, target sense and debugger behavior before use

Capture FLASH_OPTR nBOOT_SEL/nBOOT0/nBOOT1 readback before firmware/option-byte programming, after programming, after reset, and after a full power cycle; decode the resolved boot-mode selection and confirm it matches the intended boot-from-main-flash configuration; cross-check RDP/PA14 boot-failure and post-debug boot-capture errata items
